request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change only colours: the red flying cap and red tunic become near-black dark brown patched leather with one lighter brown hide patch, keeping the iron goggles; the round black bomb gets one band of hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes and a small red-orange fuse spark; his skin a brighter, more saturated yellow-olive green. Keep the face, ears, raised bomb, satchel, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
